mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.name, l.sort_order, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.id IS NOT NULL AND i.status = 'open') AS open_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.id IS NOT NULL AND i.status = 'done') AS done_count FROM todo_list l LEFT JOIN todo_item i ON i.list_id = l.id AND i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted = false WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.deleted = false GROUP BY l.id, l.name, l.sort_order ORDER BY l.sort_order ASC, l.id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM todo_list WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false
mapper.update: UPDATE todo_item SET list_id = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND list_id = #{listId} AND deleted = false
